subject: reasoning
question: Rishi starts from Point A and drives 8 km towards North. He then takes a left turn, drives 9 km, turns left and drives 12 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 13 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 4 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90° turns only, unless specified.)
solution:
Given:

Rishi starts from Point A and drives 8 km towards North.

He then takes a left turn, drives 9 km, turns left and drives 12 km.

He then takes a left turn and drives 13 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 4 km and stops at Point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1476d937ed1be74f3dd61459badb9618d2ee8ff0824bbf3391254d19074eaad7.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d1e777d5e063df7e492b219d49e7408e5c9f80289cf7016d2b7f314e7d2c290.png] 

Thus, Rishi has drive 4 km to the west to reach point A.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
